BiblicalUsage: Lot was Abraham's nephew, and the two men travelled together until their herdsmen quarrelled and they parted ways. Lot chose the well-watered plain of the Jordan and settled near Sodom, where two angels came to his house at evening. When God destroyed the cities of the plain, He remembered Abraham and sent Lot out of the overthrow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lot shows how close a man can live to judgment and still be pulled out by grace. His rescue was not earned by his choices; it was God's mercy answering Abraham's faith.
